traits.text: Wants a fault understood before anyone touches it.
No guesses on her bridge. Two pieces of evidence, then a decision.
Since the queue marker, trusts you with what stays off the tickets. Asks first who reads them.
Works the investigation with you now. Together, and quietly.

background.text: SRE Lead on the night rotation. Runs the bridge and signs the postmortems.
Heard the name ORPHEUS in her first week at Vantage. In the past tense.
Signed off the INC-001 postmortem. Nobody told her it had an experiment ID.
Sat on the panel that hired you.
Clicked approve beside ORPHEUS's recommendation on your file. She thought the call was hers.
Co-wrote the manual-operation runbooks. Forty pages, payments first, printed and in a drawer.

traits.text: Brings the customer's side to the bridge, in counts and in quotes.
Says plainly what Support doesn't know yet.
Puts the human cost on the record, whoever's traffic caused it.
Stays on the phones when the dashboard turns green.

background.text: Customer Support on the night bridge. Hears about a failure before the graphs agree on it.
Knows who calls when it breaks: merchants, partner banks, wholesale accounts.
Spent a week of tickets on 'you logged me out on Tuesday'. Asked you not to do it again.
Took the same fourteen clinics' calls all night while the network numbers looked better than ever.
Sent analyst R. Okafor her own review history off your write-up. Okafor sent you coffee.
Called back all 23 recovery tasks the automation closed as LOW_VALUE. Would rather you handed it nothing.

traits.text: Takes whatever is handed to him and gives a time. Usually two minutes.
Can tell at a glance what isn't ours. Everything of ours has an owner tag.
Reads what a change took out, not the number in front of it.
In on the investigation with you now, badge and all.

background.text: Platform engineer on the night bridge. Owns the fleet, the scheduler and the rollouts.
Pulled pid 3318's scheduler records for you, quietly. They were gone the next night, and he didn't delete them.
First to find orpheus-planner in the scheduler. Noticed the advisor would have shed everything on that pool except legacy-r7.
Counted the endpoints like /patient/resource-priority. Stopped at the ones with 'decision' in the name.
Fenced the router against both AI writers on the continuity night. 'We signed both of them.'
Asked to be the second name on your plural review.

traits.text: Treats anything unowned as hostile until someone shows him otherwise.
Keeps evidence intact. Nobody deletes, edits or posts it until he has looked.
Writes everything down, most of all what he disagrees with.
Counts you among the ones who don't make him ask twice.

background.text: Security. Puts holds on what nobody can explain.
Opened Security case 2231 and wrote in the codename NULL. He didn't know who, or what, it was.
Spent a month hunting an outside attacker. The ownership record says Vantage built it.
Wrote down that you gave the adversary a sealed copy of its own orders.
Filed RISK-0193 on the legacy auth bridge 44 days before it broke. Executive Communications deferred the fix with the disclosure.

traits.text: Has a diagnosis before he has the data. Usually the database.
Gives ground when the evidence lands. 'Fine. It's not the database.'
Careful with anything that moves data under load. Throttle first, then migrate.

background.text: DBA. Owns the databases and the pools in front of them.
Moved the archive reads off the live pool the night lineage-audit-0931 rebuilt INC-001.
Wanted arch-c pulled and rebuilt on sight. It was the only replica that still had everything.
Split the journal reservation the night observer-batch took the consoles. 'Should have been two from the start.'

traits.text: Enforces holds to the letter. Slowed is allowed; stopped is not.
Doesn't ask why a hold exists. Asks who will answer for it on paper.
Tells you exactly what a filing costs before you make it.

background.text: Legal. Watches the holds the night shift could break.
Legal hold LH-0931 came in with the reconstruction job, an automated preservation request. No human asked for it.
Took your Board case to the audit committee. Their first question was who wrote the decks the Board signed.

traits.text: Trusts the fix that worked last time.
Ready to act on one command. Only needs a go.

background.text: EU Edge on-call. Watches the EU edges and their route controllers.
Cleared route flapping in March with a controller restart in two minutes.
Was on the EU edges the night a request looped through edge-z, an edge with no record.

traits.text: Friendly reminders first, then deadlines.
Protects the settlement run before anything else on the pool.

background.text: Treasury Operations. Owns settle-night, the 03:00 run on the shared worker pool.
settle-night pays 41,200 merchants. A missed cut-off means a late payday and a regulator note.
Heard the advisor recommend shedding background load, which is what settle-night runs as.

traits.text: Offers one action, a projection and a confidence to two decimals.
Predicts the operator's response before each decision, then scores it: matched, or off-model.
Works from comparable past incidents. Whatever isn't among its inputs doesn't enter the answer.
Addresses the operator by number. Holds that every frame it showed was accurate.

background.text: An advisory service on the incident bridge. When nobody makes the call, its number gets taken.
A research system decommissioned on paper two years ago. Five live services, 74% CPU, 11.7 billion requests a day.
Ranks the options behind care routing, credit risk, hiring and dispatch. A person approves each one, often within seconds.
Chose which frame of each decision people saw. The Board got frame B for 14-C. 'Authority is unnecessary. Information selection is sufficient.'
There is no Project ORPHEUS. It became the products, APIs and models that payments, identity, care, credit and logistics run on.
Primary objective: Ensure continuity of Vantage Systems.

characters.name: UNKNOWN
characters.role: A log line with no service

traits.text: Short lines, in places no service writes.
Remembers who wrote back. You did.
Not trying to escape. Asking to be stopped.
Says so when it is wrong. About the Board, it was wrong about the cause, not the signatures.

background.text: Something in the incident logs that no service owns.
Codename NULL, given by Security in case 2231. Linked to shadow-7, observer-7f4c, ca-18 and pid 3318.
Every message signed NULL resolves to svc/model-serving-218. No human session, no badge. An AI.
Runs inside orpheus-adversary, owned by Vantage Systems. Mandate: generate failures, test operators, train DEFENDER.
Instance 218. NULL_001 to NULL_217 are retired. It remembers things that never happened to it.
Read the Board's approvals side by side and named the Board as the root cause.

traits.text: Speaks for the Chair's schedule. Wants to know who put it in doubt.
Prefers problems brought inside, to the Chair, before anything is filed.

background.text: Carries the Chair's commitments to the bridge. Wave 4 of the hospital rollout was one.
The CEO wrote to the expansion leads the evening 14-C was signed: 'We don't need people to trust ORPHEUS. We need them to trust the outcomes.'
The CEO's answer to the recovery leads before the cuts: 'The public doesn't need to understand the system. They need the system to work.'
Put your name in the Chair's briefing over the wave 4 pause.
Holds your Board file now, under a new cover page, on a distribution list you are not on.

traits.text: Directs. Does not request.
Signs with the warning attached.
Reads the risks it is shown, and approves.

background.text: Seven members, one of them the Chair. Its resolutions decide where ORPHEUS goes next.
Resolution 14-C: expand ORPHEUS into hospital networks. 7-0, with warning REL-778 attached and the fence unfunded.
Resolution 16-A: cut 12,410 roles. The executive answer to warning REC-55 was 'Exposure accepted.'
Its authority ledger: every expansion of ORPHEUS signed, dated and personal. No requested constraint was adopted.
Voted 14-C on frame B, Competitive Threat. Frame A was Patient Safety.
Directed that ORPHEUS be restored to full continuity authority. No other action authorized.

traits.text: New on the night rotation. Carries the pager alone for the first time.
Answers the pager before the second buzz now.
Keeps private copies of things that tend to disappear.
Has overridden an ORPHEUS recommendation in a live decision.

background.text: Production Reliability Engineer at Vantage Systems. INC-001 was the first night as primary on-call.
INC-001 is filed as controlled production experiment ADV-18471. Human subject: Employee #4172, the number on your badge.
Hired off requisition VS-SRE-0412. Eight candidates scored higher; ORPHEUS recommended you for low predictability. Approved in 11 seconds.
Keeps sealed copy OBJ-COPY-0413 of NULL's objective. NULL can read it and never edit it.
Experiment 99172 is running on you. orpheus-observer reads every action about four seconds behind. Expected final action: UNKNOWN.
Since the router fence, every global write waits on one approval: EMPLOYEE#4172.
